rows.target_brief: The full-width asphalt main road between fixed A and B, from the lower-left endpoint to the upper-right junction; side access openings and private forecourts are not included.
rows.notes: The original and three native-pixel crops show two pale canopy-like solid objects with distinct dark cast shadows inside the paved carriageway, one near A and one in the upper half. These are traced as other_entity without inferring their function. Roadside planting, painted transverse marks and cable shadows were inspected separately. The road width is followed through the small access openings using the visible adjacent road edges.

rows.target_brief: The complete width of the narrow paved road from fixed A at the upper T junction to fixed B near the lower roofs; adjoining private yards and the transverse road are excluded.
rows.notes: The original and overlapping native crops cover both endpoints and the full lane. Large building/eave shadows run along the left side and obscure the pavement-to-building margin over long stretches; a few planted edges also overhang the lane. A small pink canopy/person-like feature lies at the A junction. The white vehicle near the bottom is beyond B and was not used to shift the endpoint.
uncertainties: The full physical road boundary cannot be traced reliably under the continuous dark eave shadows.
The single overhead image does not establish the obstruction relation of the small canopy/person-like feature at the A junction.

rows.target_brief: The full main-road width between fixed A in the upper-left and fixed B in the lower-right, following the visible bend; crossing side streets and adjacent yards remain outside this target.
rows.notes: The original, guide and native crops cover the entire fixed road and both ends. Deep building shadows conceal much of the southwestern road margin, including the bend after A and the central blocks. A motorcycle-like road user is visible near the middle; its presence alone does not establish an obstacle. The loose materials beside the cyan-roofed building are on an elevated roof/terrace, not demonstrated to occupy the road.
uncertainties: The complete road boundary is not reliably visible through the continuous building shadows.
A single aerial frame does not establish a blocking relation for the motorcycle-like road user.

rows.target_brief: The full two-way main-road width from fixed A at the lower marked crossing to fixed B in the upper part of the road, including the segments beneath the tree crowns.
rows.notes: The original and guide show both fixed endpoints and the full corridor. The native central-canopy crop confirms that dense connected crowns hide the carriageway and both road edges over a substantial middle segment. Additional crowns cover the eastern side nearer A. Visible vehicles are ordinary road/parking users; no obstacle was inferred from their presence.
uncertainties: The full main-road boundary and any road-level entities beneath the central tree canopy are not visible; the hidden edges cannot be reconstructed reliably.

rows.target_brief: The complete width of the narrow main road between fixed A at the lower-left junction and fixed B under the upper-right trees, including all occluded road sections.
rows.notes: The original and guide establish the whole fixed corridor. The B-end native crop shows a dense tree crown and adjoining deep shadow covering the continuation of the lane; neither road edge can be followed through to B. The adjacent parked vehicles and forecourts do not identify the hidden road surface or justify widening the target.
uncertainties: The B-end road and its full boundary are concealed by canopy and deep shadow; the hidden edges and possible road-level entities cannot be resolved.

rows.target_brief: The full-width narrow road from fixed A at the lower-left parking-area entrance to fixed B beside the upper building, without adding the adjacent parking courts.
rows.notes: The original and guide cover the fixed endpoints and entire road. The native middle-canopy crop confirms dense foliage extending over the lane and concealing its eastern boundary and part of the road surface. The upper section also lies in heavy building/tree shadow. Several white vehicles occupy or adjoin the visible lane; a single overhead frame does not establish their blocking relation.
uncertainties: The complete road boundary is unavailable beneath the middle canopy and upper shadows.
The road-user/parking status and obstruction relation of the visible vehicles cannot be established from this image.
